storyParagraphs: I am a full-stack engineer and designer with a deep fascination for building high-speed, intuitive web experiences. Over the past several years, I have worked across the entire technology stack—from low-latency backend APIs and relational database architectures to modern reactive frontend applications and component design systems.

My approach pairs strict software engineering discipline with fine design intuition. I believe that extraordinary software isn't just reliable and maintainable behind the scenes; it must also communicate clearly, feel tactile, and respect the user's attention.

When I'm not writing production code or profiling web performance, I explore autonomous agent workflows, open-source utilities, and write technical articles sharing insights with the developer community.
